name: Ant and Elephant
shortDescription: The animals choose tiny Ant as their king, but an elephant prince refuses to respect smaller creatures.
longDescription: When the animals elect Ant as their new king, the powerful prince of elephants ignores the ants and their territory. King Ant teaches him that everyone deserves respect, no matter how small.
